caption: A crystal chandelier catches afternoon sunlight, and little flecks of rainbow light scatter across the walls and ceiling.

sa.check: A crystal chandelier hangs in sunlight.
Flecks of rainbow light scatter across the walls and ceiling.

pc.expect: The flecks appear only while the sun hits the crystals and vanish when the sun is blocked.
pc.fail: They are there with the sun blocked; or the crystals are in sun with no flecks; or the flecks are on the sun side only.

pc.expect: The flecks move only when the chandelier sways.
pc.fail: They dance with the chandelier still; or stay put while it sways; or flicker in steady sun.
They are all white; or a single colour; or they change colour with nothing moving.

pc.expect: The flecks are many small spots.
pc.fail: They merge into one flood; or are large squares; or a single spot.
A second appears; or it vanishes; or a fleck becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.
Furniture rearranges; or the walls change; or the chandelier changes shape.
